referenceRoleInstructions.face_reference: Preserve only authorized facial identity and proportions; never copy smile, gaze, head pose, clothing, setting or style.
referenceRoleInstructions.style_reference: Use only its lighting, palette, contrast, texture and photographic mood; do not copy identity, pose, clothing or scene content.
referenceRoleInstructions.pose_reference: Use only its body arrangement, gesture and framing intent; do not copy identity, clothing, setting or visual style.
referenceRoleInstructions.product_reference: Use only the authorized product identity, shape, material and visible details; do not copy its source layout, setting or style.
referenceRoleInstructions.environment_reference: Use only the authorized location, spatial layout and environmental materials; do not copy people, clothing or unrelated objects.

referenceBoundaryInstruction: Reference roles are exclusive. Current Shot action, expression, gaze, posture, prop staging and light outrank incidental reference content.
multiViewInstruction: Use sheets and catalog images only as evidence; output one continuous Scene frame, never a sheet, collage, split screen, inset or repeated person.
preserveOutfitInstruction: Preserve the approved Look and garment details while the current Shot controls pose, expression and action.
replaceOutfitInstruction: Replace source clothing only with the explicitly approved outfit reference while preserving Character identity and proportions.
narrativeBehaviorInstructions: Render an observed narrative moment, not a posed portrait, fashion image or sales presentation.
Reference expressions are not performance authority: do not add a friendly micro-smile or direct camera gaze unless the current Shot explicitly requires it.
Keep natural asymmetry in head, shoulders, hands and weight; do not square the body into a welcoming camera-facing stance unless authored.
Keep every prop at the authored hand, body height and angle; do not raise, center or turn it toward camera for readability unless that display is the authored action.
baselinePhotographicInstructions: Create one physically plausible live-action frame with readable Scene context, moderate depth separation and motivated available or practical light.
The authored light controls exposure: preserve subject-to-background contrast and falloff; do not add beauty fill, lift the face or activate an unrequested fixture.

photorealistic-cinematic: Use source-consistent unretouched skin and restrained digital-camera response with natural highlight roll-off, subtle sensor noise in darker tones and slight optical softness; keep imperfections unobtrusive.

constraintInstructions: No glossy retouch, plastic skin, illustration, anime or CGI; no exaggerated grain, aberration, halation, HDR, sharpness or bokeh.
No duplicate people, copied sheet layout, impossible reflections or unauthorized objects.
